children: are sharply expanding their U.S. delivery partnership, making Costco available through Uber Eats in 47 states and nearly 600 warehouses. The move gives Costco another way to extend its membership model beyond the physical warehouse while strengthening Uber's push to become a broader everyday-commerce platform rather than simply a ride-hailing and restaurant-delivery app.
Costco members can now order groceries, fresh produce, household essentials, bulk products and Costco-exclusive merchandise through Uber Eats for either scheduled or on-demand delivery.
Customers enter their Costco membership information during checkout to access member pricing, while Uber handles ordering, delivery scheduling and real-time tracking.
The companies are also tying the expansion more closely to their respective membership programs.

Eligible Costco members can receive 50% off an annual Uber One membership during the first year and 20% off in following years. Participating Costco locations and Costco.com will also temporarily offer $100 Uber or Uber Eats gift cards for $79.99.

Customers who purchase a Costco membership through Uber Eats can receive 30% off their first qualifying Costco order. Uber One members, meanwhile, receive no Uber fees on eligible grocery and retail orders above $60.
Costco already works with Uber Eats internationally in Canada, Mexico, Japan, Taiwan, France and Spain.

"Costco is one of the largest and most trusted retailers in the country for good reason, and our nationwide partnership demonstrates the scale and opportunity Uber can bring to retailers looking to meet more of consumers' everyday shopping needs," Uber COO Andrew Macdonald said.
For Uber investors, the biggest opportunity is increasing order frequency outside restaurants by adding high-value grocery and bulk-shopping transactions.
Investors should watch grocery gross bookings, Uber One membership growth and whether retail delivery improves margins rather than simply adding low-profit volume.
For Costco, the key test is whether delivery increases spending and membership engagement without weakening the warehouse economics that underpin its model.

If both companies can convert the partnership into recurring orders, the deal could deepen customer loyalty on both platforms. The risk is that delivery incentives and discounts prove expensive without materially changing shopping behavior.

title: Costco Takes Delivery Push to New Level
